measurement: issue255 candidate, whole-generation overlap, and synthetic stress

scope.candidate: Three independent real Markdown/CSharp/JavaScript/Python snapshots; baseline artifact captured before implementation.
scope.stress: Ten copies of current harvested nodes with disjoint source/canonical identities. Bodies/typed data are shared immutable inputs; authored references cleared to isolate automatic policy cost. Common case assigns every clone the same explicit nonderived component.
scope.peaks: Managed heap and process working/private bytes sampled every 20ms during build; sampled peaks may miss shorter bursts. OS process lifetime peak working set also reported. Process includes test runner; no per-snapshot attribution is claimed.
scope.overlap: First whole cached generation stays strongly reachable (Memo/cache/aggregator) through all later phases, not merely its consumer rows.
scope.serialization: Complete web JSON bytes measured outside build allocation/timing/peak interval; no payload trimming or limit change.
scope.thresholds: None; maintainers dispose material regressions and existing payload-limit overflow using recorded evidence.
